Summing n+1 from 2 through 2007 gives 2017033; the 501 indices 5, 9, ..., 2005 each need one duplicate removed, giving 2016532, D. Preserve the root-approved complete existing unit-circle and sine-factorization OR routes. records.reason: Under finite integer subset counts, 2^101+2^c=2^u forces c=101 and u=102: unequal exponents would leave an odd factor greater than 1 after factoring out the smaller power of 2. In the union, A,B,C omit 2, 2, 1 elements, respectively, so the triple intersection has at least 102-5=97 elements. Disjoint omission sets attain it. The alternative membership count gives 301<=2*102+intersection, the same sharp bound. Retain both valid alternatives and the intended finite-set convention; an unrequested infinite-cardinal interpretation does not automatically create a grading defect.
